<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/resources/{id}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Copy the complete Resource ID returned by the server. For `protocol.device`, the ID is the Aqara Open `deviceId` and can be used as the device parameter for device APIs and point tools.
Network, Point, and Job resources use their respective node IDs.

Do not pass a protocol address, candidate ID, or a self-constructed device alias.

Network/Device/Point details include `properties.protocolId` (read-only protocol type), `schema`, `health`, `commands`, and `unavailableCommands`. They do not return a top-level `protocolId`, a duplicated `deviceId`, or `controlReference`. A health snapshot does not mean an active probe succeeded. Sensitive configuration is not returned.

Business control selectors should be obtained from the device definition or capability APIs.
